sections.title: Masks
sections.note: Young Link's trade slot: from Malon's egg to the Mask of Truth. Tick each item when you get it.

items.name: Weird Egg
items.howTo: Malon gives it to you by the vines near the castle gate.
items.notes: It hatches into a Cucco when morning comes.

items.name: Cucco
items.howTo: Let the Weird Egg hatch, then wake Talon, asleep by the crates at the castle, with its crow.
items.notes: Talon runs home to Lon Lon Ranch, and you can then climb his crates into the castle grounds.

items.name: Zelda's Letter
items.howTo: Zelda gives it to you in the castle courtyard.
items.notes: Show it to the guard at the Death Mountain gate in Kakariko Village to open the trail and the Happy Mask Shop.

items.name: Keaton Mask
items.howTo: Borrow it from the Happy Mask Shop in Hyrule Market and sell it to the guard at Kakariko's Death Mountain gate.

items.name: Skull Mask
items.howTo: Sell it to the Skull Kid on the stump left of the Lost Woods entrance, after playing him Saria's Song.
items.notes: Wear it on the Forest Stage for the 30 Deku Sticks upgrade.

items.name: Spooky Mask
items.howTo: Sell it to the boy in Kakariko Graveyard, by day.

items.name: Bunny Hood
items.howTo: Sell it to the Running Man in Hyrule Field. He appears once you have all three Spiritual Stones, and only stops to talk at night.
items.notes: Get the biggest wallet you can first. StrategyWiki places him around Lon Lon Ranch; Zelda Wiki says he runs around Hyrule Field.

items.name: Mask of Truth
items.howTo: The Happy Mask Shop lends it to you once you've sold all four masks.
items.notes: Lets you hear Gossip Stones. Wear it on the Forest Stage for a Deku Nut upgrade before you get the Poacher's Saw (N64). The shop then also lends the Goron, Zora and Gerudo Masks, which nobody buys.

sections.title: Biggoron's Sword
sections.note: Adult Link's trade slot. Don't warp while a timed item is in hand: it spoils at once.

items.name: Pocket Egg
items.howTo: Talk to the Cucco Lady in Kakariko Village as adult Link.
items.notes: It hatches into the Pocket Cucco the next morning (play the Sun's Song to hurry it).

items.name: Pocket Cucco
items.howTo: Let the Pocket Egg hatch, then use it to wake Talon, asleep in a house in Kakariko Village.

items.name: Cojiro
items.howTo: Give the Pocket Cucco back to the Cucco Lady once it has woken Talon; she trades it for her brother's blue Cucco.

items.name: Odd Mushroom
items.howTo: Take Cojiro to the man slumped against a tree in the Lost Woods, left from the Kokiri Forest entrance.
items.notes: Timed: three minutes to reach the potion shop.

items.name: Odd Potion
items.howTo: Within three minutes, give the Odd Mushroom to Granny in the potion shop behind Kakariko's main potion shop.
items.notes: Called the Odd Poultice in Ocarina of Time 3D. If time runs out, fetch another mushroom with Cojiro.

items.name: Poacher's Saw
items.howTo: Take the Odd Potion back to the same spot in the Lost Woods; Fado is there now and swaps it for the saw.
items.notes: On the N64, getting the saw makes the Mask of Truth's Deku Nut upgrade on the Forest Stage unobtainable, so get that first. Fixed on the 3DS.

items.name: Broken Goron's Sword
items.howTo: Give the saw to the head carpenter in his tent in Gerudo Valley. Cross the broken bridge with Epona or the Longshot, or after rescuing the carpenters.

items.name: Prescription
items.howTo: Give the broken sword to Biggoron at the summit of Death Mountain Trail.

items.name: Eyeball Frog
items.howTo: Thaw King Zora with Blue Fire (Ice Cavern) and show him the Prescription.
items.notes: Timed: three minutes to reach the Lakeside Laboratory.

items.name: World's Finest Eye Drops
items.howTo: Within three minutes, give the Eyeball Frog to the scientist in the Lakeside Laboratory.
items.notes: Timed: four minutes to get back to Biggoron. If time runs out, get another frog from King Zora.

items.name: Claim Check
items.howTo: Within four minutes, give the eye drops to Biggoron.

items.name: Biggoron's Sword
items.howTo: Wait three days (or play the Sun's Song six times), then show Biggoron the Claim Check.
items.notes: Two-handed and unbreakable: twice the Master Sword's power.
